rows.text: Singtel achieved a 70% carbon emissions intensity reduction in 2020, exceeding its 2030 target of 50%.

rows.text: Singtel is committed to achieving net zero by 2050 and its 2030 SBTi absolute carbon reduction targets.
rows.source_sentence: We are also committed to achieving our 2030 SBTi absolute carbon reduction target of 42% for Scope 1 and 2 and 30% reduction for Scope 3 from 2015 baseline.
